item.title: Parametric Laser-Cut Plywood Tool Organizer: CadQuery and 3D-Printed Hardware
item.description: Organizing hand tools in an apartment closet is always an exercise in frustrating trade-offs. Off-the-shelf plastic toolboxes and generic storage bins are bulky, awkward, and notoriously inefficient inside standard cabinetry. A typical closet shelf is deep (>50 cm), but most commercial organizers are shallow (wasting valuable front or rear space) or require digging through stacked tool layers like an archaeological excavation. To maximize every cubic centimeter of a dedicated closet shelf (467 × 525 × 280 mm), I designed a custom modular birch plywood tool organizer.
